verdict.rationale: Email aliases or masked addresses are a fair capability to ask of an email service like Outlook, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents creating aliases or masked/relay addresses to hide the real address. The closest item, delegated send-on-behalf, is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
